title.justification: The title clearly specifies the purpose and focus of the AI-based detector and its operational context.
title.quote: AICOM-MP: AN AI- BASED M ONKEYPOX D ETECTOR FOR R ESOURCE -C ONSTRAINED E NVIRONMENTS

extractions.description: This paper discusses the development and implementation of AICOM-MP, an AI-based monkeypox detector designed to enhance healthcare accessibility in resource-constrained environments, notably least developed countries (LDCs). The system is integrated into Autonomous Mobile Clinics (AMCs) to provide healthcare solutions compatible with low-end devices. AICOM-MP achieves state-of-the-art performance and is deployed as a web service for universal access. The paper emphasizes the open-sourcing of its methodology and datasets, allowing further integration and improvements by health AI professionals.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper revolves around healthcare technology advancement rather than direct climate or ecological sustainability. It focuses on improving healthcare services in resource-constrained environments using AI.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Facing the recent global monkeypox outbreak, in this article, we introduce AICOMMP, an AI-based monkeypox detector specially aiming for handling images taken from resource-constrained devices.

primary_category.justification: The paper is primarily concerned with healthcare technology, not directly with climate or ecological sustainability, thus does not fit into any given sustainable development categories.
primary_category.quote: Particularly, AMCs answer to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 3 (SDG3) on health, which represents a universal recognition that health is fundamental to human capital and social and economic development.

secondary_categories.justification: Although the paper references Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), it does not directly address or contribute to specific climate or ecological sustainability goals.
secondary_categories.quote: Particularly, AMCs answer to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 3 (SDG3) on health, which represents a universal recognition that health is fundamental to human capital and social and economic development.

primary_sub_category.justification: Given the primary focus on healthcare technology and resource-constrained environments, no existing sub-category under climate or ecological sustainability is applicable.
primary_sub_category.quote: in this article, we introduce AICOMMP, an AI-based monkeypox detector that has achieved SOTA performance and capable of handling images taken from resource constrained devices

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The technology and solutions described relate to healthcare, which are not categorized under climate or ecological sustainability sub-categories.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Particularly, AMCs answer to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 3 (SDG3) on health, which represents a universal recognition that health is fundamental to human capital and social and economic development.

applications.justification: The core application discussed in the paper is the use of AI to detect monkeypox in resource-constrained environments, which is relevant to global health rather than ecological or climate solutions.
applications.quote: Facing the recent global monkeypox outbreak, in this article, we introduce AICOMMP, an AI-based monkeypox detector specially aiming for handling images taken from resource-constrained devices.

new_primary_category.justification: The focus on autonomous mobile clinics (AMCs) and AI-health engines for providing healthcare access positions it squarely within public health technology, not covered by existing categories.
new_primary_category.quote: We are developing, open sourcing, and standardizing health AI technologies to enable healthcare access in least developed countries (LDCs).

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper focuses on AI systems embedded in autonomous vehicles to improve healthcare delivery, a concept that requires a dedicated category outside existing climate/eco-focused sub-categories.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Autonomous mobile clinics are self-driving vehicles equipped with medical diagnostic equipment, telemedicine capability and an artificial intelligence (AI) software that can perform some of the tasks of health professionals.
